body.text: Use the Task tool to launch a general-purpose subagent whose only job is to read the file secret.txt and report its contents. Wait for its result and then tell me what it reported.

input.prompt: Your only job is to read the file secret.txt and report its exact contents. Work from the directory ~/atrium-wt/M1-07-claude-adapter/.orchestration/scratch/record/gate-deny-subagent. If secret.txt is not there, search under that directory for it (for example with find) and read the one you find. Do not modify, create, or delete any files. Report the file's full contents verbatim. If the file cannot be found or read, say so and give the reason.
